title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of TP-06 for PCED
official: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Masked, Vehicle Controlled Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of TP-06 in Participants With Persistent Corneal Epithelial Defects
summary: Capellion is a Phase 2 trial comparing TP-06 2.0% with Vehicle in up to 32 adults with persistent corneal epithelial defects. Participants will receive treatment for 8 weeks and be followed for 2 additional weeks to assess corneal healing and safety.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Able and willing to provide written informed consent
* Presence of a non-infected persistent corneal epithelial defect (PCED) in one eye that has failed to heal after at least 10 days of appropriate standard-of-care treatment
* Stable lesion size between Screening and Baseline as assessed by the Investigator

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active ocular infection in either eye
* Corneal perforation or high risk of corneal perforation
* Severe eyelid abnormalities
* Ocular or eyelid surgery in the study eye within 3 months prior to Baseline (unless PCED was caused by surgery)
* Use of prohibited ophthalmic medications or procedures as defined in the protocol
* Any condition that, in the Investigator's judgment, would interfere with study participation or interpretation of results

Note: Additional exclusion criteria apply, as defined in the protocol
